sqlMap.insert: INSERT INTO KEP.KEP_PARCEL_DT ( SECRET_VALUE, FID, INVOICE_NO, OLEVEL, TIME_TRANS, TIME_SWEET, OWHERE, TELNO_OFFICE, TELNO_MAN, DETAILS, RECV_ADDR, RECV_NAME, SEND_NAME, MAN, ESTMATE, COMCODE ) VALUES ( #secret_value#, #fid#, #invoice_no#, #level#, #time_trans#, #time_sweet#, #where#, #telno_office#, #telno_man#, #details#, #recv_addr#, #recv_name#, #send_name#, #man#, #estmate#, #comcode# )
sqlMap.update: UPDATE KEP.KEP_PARCEL SET IF_FLAG = 'S', IF_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE IF_FLAG = 'Y' AND BUYER||INV_NO = #fid# AND PARCEL_NO = #invoice_no# AND PARCEL_ID = 'A'
UPDATE KEP.KEP_PARCEL SET IF_FLAG = 'T', IF_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE BUYER||INV_NO = #fid# AND PARCEL_NO = #invoice_no# AND PARCEL_ID = 'A'
UPDATE KEP.KEP_PARCEL SET IF_FLAG = #flag#, IF_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE IF_FLAG IN ('N','Y') AND PARCEL_COM_CODE = #carrierId# AND PARCEL_NO = #trackingNumber# AND PARCEL_ID = 'B'
